svg.title: Why the window is 48 tokens
svg.desc: In panel a, the cumulative share of 5,571 voice replies by their output tokens, 23 at the median and 52 at most, 21% ending within a 16-token window and all but 1 within a 48-token one; in panel b, the p95 of a 40-token reply's last token by the window, the median of two runs (16 tokens 3.76 s; 24 tokens 2.64 s; 32 tokens 1.85 s; 48 tokens 1.04 s; 64 tokens 1.02 s), its first token's staying between 326 and 448 ms; in panel c, the agents' prompt tokens a second by the window's tokens, 3,483 at 16, 3,443 at 24, 3,300 at 32, 3,205 at 48, 3,246 at 64, 8% less at 48 than at 16.
